text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It is used in many everyday tools. For example, NLP allows machines to read and understand text, so they can answer questions or find important information. It also powers translation apps, which change words from one language into another. Another common use is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP makes chatbots possible. These programs can talk with people online and give helpful replies. Thanks to NLP, our technology communicates with us more naturally than ever before.
